meta.title: soundtag
meta.voiceInstructions: Calm, precise, a maker showing you something they built. Not an advert.

scenes.narration: A song you send someone is a link in a chat. It is gone by the time they scroll past it.
scenes.headline: soundtag

scenes.narration: Paste a Spotify link and the code becomes a thing you can turn, at the size it will print.
The plate stops at one height and the code starts exactly there. One filament change for the whole print, not one per layer.
Five shapes. Add a title and the tag grows to fit it, because the code is the point of the object.
The same build on the command line, and it tells you which layer to swap on.
MIT, no upload, no account. Everything it claims was measured, and what was not is written down.
